title: VXAce Running from battle as a character command.

posts.author: TheGreatAeonXII
posts.body:
So, lemme get straight to the point. In RPG Maker VX Ace you have the escape option which may make all the characters flee from battle. Personally however, I think only allowing the whole party to be able to flee is overly punitive, since failing to escape battle leaves the party completely at mercy to enemies. Which is why I want a system where other characters are able to do other actions in case the running attempt fails. An example of such a system can be seen in the first Final Fantasy.
While I could request for a script, I want to know if I can actually do a system like this by just using events (And maybe changing the Windows scripts a little?) Hopefully it can work well enough.
Also, just in case this matters, I'm using CP's Battle Engine v1.2b

only if you limit the formula to that - there is a reason why I mentioned "a lot of control variable commands".
The default formula takes the average of the entire party AGI and compares it to the average of all enemy AGI, so you'll need four control variable commands to load all actor AGI, then a few more to calculate the average, then do the same for an unknown number of enemies. Then combine both averages to the percentage created by the original formula before checking that escape chance.

posts.author: EntangledPear
posts.body:
If you want to use a specific actor's (the user's) AGI to calculate the escape chance, you can do it like this (I think there is a script call that would get you the "user" stuff, and maybe someone will provide it, but this is how I do it):
- in the escape skill, in the damage formula, put in v[N]=a.id (since escape doesn't have any damage, I'd recommend using
Hime's Formula Effects
script, which allows you to add this in the note window), which will remember the user's ID in variable N
- set the skill to call the common event
- in the common event, set enemy agility, however you wish it (I had it as always the first enemy's agility, but I'm not sure how it would work if that enemy was already dead - haven't had any crashes, but maybe I didn't try to escape in later rounds), then character agility as the user's one (this can be done by assigning the variable using a script: $game_actors[$game_variables[N]].param(6), where param(6) is AGI)
- then do the escape chance calculations - my formula was 150 - (enemy AGI*100 / actor AGI) - which is what you have there as the escape ratio
- decide when the chance is high enough to be successful, if it is, abort battle (mine is higher than 50)
- I also count escape attempts and add something to the escape chance if there had been more
Now, I haven't tested it yet with the user's AGI (just like with enemy AGI, I originally had it set to one specific actor), but it should work.
As Andar said, in your common event, you assign variable 1, Char Agi, a certain number, then immediately another number, which overwrites the first number, and so on, so you're essentially only getting Ming's AGI worked with in the end.
I'll be happy to explain further if you need it (I'm not an expert by any means, but I'll do what I can).
